technical_complexity.rationale: Needs scraping or data access to profiles and automated judgment of each person against criteria, doable with 2022 machine learning but with accuracy and data access limits.

defensibility.rationale: No proprietary data; later large language models made the core evaluation step easy to copy.

market_need_then: Sales prospecting tooling was an established spend category; no company specific demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Used ponyrun.ai; one profile says the company was formerly known as Nimbus, unverified.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain statement on YC page: Ponyrun evaluates people for you

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand found.

outcome_analysis: Ponyrun built an AI prospect research tool and was in YC Winter 2022 with a three person team. A database lists a convertible note in March 2022 and about 1.9 million dollars raised in total. The YC directory marks it inactive, but no shutdown post, acquisition or cause was found, so the cause of failure is not public and no failure factors are asserted.
notes: Company site returned HTTP 503 at fetch time, not worked around. Funding rests on one database (CB Insights), which reports about 1.9M total over two rounds and lists the convertible note; the other round is unidentified. Founder education not found. Competition list left empty: the only prospect research searches returned 2024 or later material. Status in CB Insights was Alive, YC says Inactive.
